notes.content: GEOL 10L, Physical Geology Lab, may be taken concurrently, or following, GEOL 10. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Geology is compatible with the B.S. in Geology at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. For more information please visit: Department of Geology .
